questions.question: Apex Motors, a high -end automobile manufacturer, recently introduced the "Terra GT," an electric SUV. Apex historically catered to rugged, outdoor -oriented drivers. However, for the Terra GT, marketing framed the vehicle as "Sophisticated Luxury for the El ite Professional." Apex priced it at $85,000, placed advertisements in high -end business journals, and selected minimalist, gallery-style showrooms with highly formal sales staff. Page 3 Simultaneously, Lumina Tech released a smart home assistant called "Echo Sphere." During its pre-launch, Lumina ran high-energy TV spots featuring energetic music and humorous scenarios to drive engagement. However, in the first month post-launch, customers suffered frequent server outages and app crashes. While early buyers found the advertisements fun, overall reviews plummeted due to reliability failures. A perceptual mapping analysis comparing Terra GT, Echo Sphere, and key competitors revealed the following positioning insights: • Terra GT: Consumers perceived it as overpriced and excessively formal, leaving a gap in its traditional "rugged, highly durable utility" space. Existing Apex owners expressed confusion over who the brand was trying to be. • Echo Sphere: Consumers rated the product high on "Excitement" due to its advertising, but exceptionally low on "Competence" due to functional failures. Questions a. Explain the elements of the consumer perception process in the context of Apex's Terra GT. How did Apex's marketing mix cues (use 4 Ps of marketing) lead to perceptual distortion among traditional Apex customers? b. Based on the case, analyse how Apex can use perceptual mapping for Market Segmentation and Brand Repositioning to address customer confusion. c. Using Aaker’s Brand Personality framework, contrast Lumina Tech's marketing image with its real product performance. What identity conflict did this create for consumers? What are the long-term consequences on consumer attitudes and learning when communication and service experiences contradict each other? ,[CO4] [1 x 20 = 20]
